# Pakem Framework

> Look like Laravel, Run at Rust Speed.
> Menenun mahakarya perangkat lunak modern dengan ketelitian canting dan kekuatan pakem berkecepatan Rust.

Pakem Framework adalah web framework modern berkecepatan tinggi untuk bahasa pemrograman Rust, dirancang dengan sintaks deklaratif, ergonomis, dan batteries-included yang familiar bagi developer Laravel.

## Ringkasan Ekosistem (Ecosystem Overview)
- **Nama Crate**: `pakem` (v1.0.1 di crates.io) & `pakem-framework` (v1.0.0)
- **CLI Toolchain**: `canting` (`cargo install canting`)
- **Procedural Macros**: `pakem_macros` (`#[derive(PakemModel)]`, `#[pakem_form]`)
- **Reactive Server-Driven UI**: `pakem-live`
- **Domain Resmi**: https://pakem.my.id
- **Repositori Utama**: https://github.com/pakem-rs/framework
- **Starter Application Skeleton**: https://github.com/pakem-rs/pakem
- **Lisensi**: MIT Open Source License

## Pilar Utama Arsitektur (Architectural Pillars)
1. **Laravel Elegance (Ergonomi Tanpa Boilerplate)**:
   - Satu parameter tunggal pada controller: `req: Request` (Unified Request bundle).
   - Return type standar: `impl IntoResponse` (HTML View) atau `PakemResult` (JSON API).
   - Fluent Eloquent ORM: Query builder deklaratif `User::query(req.db()).where_eq("status", "active").get().await?`.
   - One-Line Relationships: `has_many!(Post, "user_id")`, `belongs_to!(User, "user_id")`.
   - Native Blade Template Engine: Ekstensi `.blade.rs` dengan `@extends`, `@section`, `@foreach`, `@auth`, dan filter pipa `| rupiah`.
   - Dynamic Scripting & WASM Sandbox: Integrasi plugin `.wasm` dan skrip bahasa Indonesia `.is`.

2. **Raw Rust Speed & Safety (Performa Maksimal)**:
   - Tokio Async Runtime + Axum HTTP Engine.
   - Benchmark: Latensi respons sub-milidetik (< 0.5ms), 118.000+ RPS, memory footprint hemat (~15MB RAM).
   - Zero-Panic Error Boundary (`catch_unwind`) mencegah crash runtime.

3. **Canting CLI (Artisan Tooling)**:
   - `canting new <nama_proyek>`: Inisialisasi proyek baru siap produksi.
   - `canting tinker`: Interactive REPL shell dengan persistent history `.pakem_tinker_history`.
   - `canting make:controller`, `canting make:model`, `canting make:migration`.
   - `canting migrate`, `canting migrate:rollback`, `canting db:seed`.

4. **Official Starter Kits & Enterprise Safety**:
   - Pakem Aurora Starter Kit: Autentikasi lengkap (login, register, reset password, dashboard) dengan Tailwind CSS murni tanpa Node.js runtime bloat.
   - Enterprise Security: Autentikasi dual (Session Cookie + JWT Bearer), Anti Brute-Force lockout, Granular RBAC (`@can`, `@role`), dan Audit Trail ISO 27001.

## Indeks Dokumentasi Resmi (Documentation Links)
- [01. Instalasi & Persyaratan](https://pakem.my.id/01_instalasi_dan_persyaratan): Panduan setup Rust, SQLite, dan instalasi `canting`.
- [02. Routing & Middleware](https://pakem.my.id/02_routing_dan_middleware): Sistem router Axum elegan dan custom middleware.
- [03. Controller & Unified Request](https://pakem.my.id/03_controller_dan_request): Penjelasan Unified Request bundle dan shortcut respons `req.ok()`, `req.paginate()`.
- [04. Model, Query Builder & Factory](https://pakem.my.id/04_model_dan_eloquent_orm): Makro `#[derive(PakemModel)]`, fluent query, dan database factory.
- [05. Native Blade Template Engine](https://pakem.my.id/05_blade_template_engine): Sintaks blade, layout inheritance, dan filter kustom.
- [06. WASM Sandbox & Plugins](https://pakem.my.id/06_wasm_sandbox_dan_plugin): Menjalankan modul WebAssembly berisolasi tinggi.
- [07. Indonesian Script (.is)](https://pakem.my.id/07_indonesian_script): Kompilator skrip dinamis berbasis bahasa Indonesia.
- [08. Autentikasi Dual (Session + JWT)](https://pakem.my.id/08_autentikasi_dan_keamanan): Multi-guard authentication untuk Web & RESTful API.
- [09. Broadcasting & WebSocket](https://pakem.my.id/09_broadcasting_dan_websocket): Realtime bi-directional events via WebSocket Echo.
- [10. Queue Jobs & Cron Scheduler](https://pakem.my.id/10_queue_jobs_dan_scheduler): Pemrosesan asinkron latar belakang dan jadwal berulang.
- [11. Observabilitas & Telescope](https://pakem.my.id/11_observabilitas_dan_telescope): Monitoring query SQL, request log, dan latency profiling.
- [12. Deployment & DevOps](https://pakem.my.id/12_deployment_dan_devops): Panduan Docker, Systemd, Nginx reverse proxy, dan VPS.
- [13. Pakem Live (Reactive UI)](https://pakem.my.id/13_pakem_live_server_driven_ui): Komponen reaktif server-driven ala Livewire.
- [14. Pakem Aurora Starter Kit](https://pakem.my.id/14_pakem_aurora_starter_kit): Full authentication scaffold & admin UI.
- [15. Enterprise Security & Zero Panic](https://pakem.my.id/15_enterprise_security_dan_zero_panic): Zero-Panic error boundary dan compliance enterprise.
- [16. Benchmark & Performance Whitepaper](https://pakem.my.id/16_benchmark_dan_performance_whitepaper): Data teknis RPS, latensi, dan komparasi dengan framework lain.
- [17. Universal Storage & Redis Suite](https://pakem.my.id/17_universal_storage_dan_redis_suite): S3 object storage, SigV4 presigned URL, dan Redis cache.
- [18. API-First & Testing Kit](https://pakem.my.id/18_api_first_openapi_swagger_dan_testing_kit): OpenAPI v3 auto-generation, Swagger UI, dan fluent test assertions.
- [19. Advanced Eloquent & Model Observers](https://pakem.my.id/19_advanced_eloquent_model_observers_dan_seeding): Lifecycle hooks, soft deletes, dan transaction manager.
- [20. Pakem Tinker REPL](https://pakem.my.id/20_canting_tinker): Terminal interaktif untuk menguji model dan query secara instan.
- [21. WASM Hot Reloading](https://pakem.my.id/21_wasm_plugins_hot_reload): Pemuatan ulang plugin dinamis tanpa restart server host.
- [22. AI Ready Architecture & Agent Skills](https://pakem.my.id/22_ai_agent_context_and_skills): Auto-generate AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, copilot, dan SKILL.md.
- [23. Pakem Hardware Bridge](https://pakem.my.id/23_pakem_hardware_bridge): Integrasi POS thermal printer USB, barcode scanner, dan biometrik.
- [24. Pakem Desktop Engine](https://pakem.my.id/24_pakem_desktop_engine): Kompilasi aplikasi web menjadi executable desktop native ringan.
